_comment: The ONE place the agency identity lives. Swap this file + templates/tokens.css + assets/logo/* to re-skin the whole factory for another agency. Studio Rantai is a FICTIONAL agency used for this public demo.
name: Studio Rantai
philosophy: Ideas before price lists. We build narratives.
mission: Connect brands with like-minded creators through campaigns that start from a story, not a rate card.

pillars.label: Insight first
pillars.desc: Every campaign starts from a human truth about the audience, not a product feature.

pillars.label: Story second
pillars.desc: We turn that insight into a named idea with an arc creators can actually tell.

pillars.label: Craft always
pillars.desc: Briefing, production and reporting run on checklists, so the idea survives execution.
